title: Interval Added for a Vehicle Serviced under a Care Plan
content:
A vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing that is being serviced under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan has interval added to the next grant, and what is counted is the completed visits standing on that plan in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date.

| Completed Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan visits in the window | Added |
| --- | --- |
| 3 or more | 2000 miles |
| 1 or 2 | 750 miles |
| none | 0 miles |

As clauses: a vehicle with three or more completed Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan visits in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date has 2000 miles added; one with one or two completed care plan visits in that window has 750 miles added; and one with no completed care plan visit in that window has nothing added on this ground.

*Where the count divides.* At 3 completed visits inside the window the first row governs; at 2 the second; at none the third. A visit dated twenty-six months back is outside the window and is not counted, and a visit that was not completed is not counted at all.
